page_title: STU 0-5 BAY | Stuttgart v Bayern Munich 06/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.

90+3' Excellent touch by Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich)! He latches on to an inch-perfect pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper reacts superbly and makes a save.
90+3' Neat passing move from Bayern Munich in order to create new attacking opportunities.

90+1' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the middle of the goal, but Alexander Nubel pulls off an easy save.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
89' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Finn Jeltsch (VfB Stuttgart) replacing Deniz Undav.
89' Substitution. Jamie Leweling makes way for Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart).
88' 0 - 5 Goal Harry Kane (Bayern Munich)! Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) was put through by Michael Olise and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the back of the net. 0:5.
87' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) gets inside the box and tries to beat Jonas Urbig with a measured shot into the bottom left corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.

85' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
83' The referee signals a substitution. Hiroki Ito (Bayern Munich) is brought on as a substitute for Dayot Upamecano.
83' The attendance is 60000.
82' 0 - 4 GOAL! That’s a perfect strike from the spot by Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) into the top left hand corner, giving goalkeeper Alexander Nubel no chance!
82' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
81' The referee shows a red card! Lorenz Assignon (VfB Stuttgart) has to leave the pitch.
81' Lorenz Assignon (VfB Stuttgart) touches the ball with his hand. The referee makes a call and blows his whistle for an infringement. Bayern Munich are awarded a penalty.
80' A decent cross into the box is met first time by Michael Olise (Bayern Munich), but his powerful goalbound effort is superbly blocked by a defender.

78' 0 - 3 Goal! Luis Diaz puts Josip Stanisic (Bayern Munich) in the clear with just the keeper to beat. He takes his shot early from the edge of the box and scores beautifully into the bottom left corner. 0:3.
76' The corner by Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.
74' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to make a change. Lorenz Assignon (VfB Stuttgart) replaces Josha Vagnoman.
74' Tiago Tomas comes onto the pitch because Bilal El Khannouss (VfB Stuttgart) simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.

70' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) struck the ball which rebounded to the edge of the box. His attempt went narrowly over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Bayern Munich will have a goal kick.
70' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.

66' 0 - 2 Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) scores an incredible goal! He receives a pass, makes some space for himself and unleashes a long-range thunderbolt of a shot past the goalkeeper into the bottom left corner.
65' Bayern Munich are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
62' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) is given a yellow card.
61' Here comes a substitution. Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) is brought on as a substitute for Nikolas Nartey.
61' Vincent Kompany has decided to substitute Leon Goretzka and he is replaced by Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich).
61' Substitution. Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Raphael Guerreiro walks off.
60' Vincent Kompany decides to make a substitution. Nicolas Jackson will be replaced by Harry Kane (Bayern Munich).
60' The resulting corner from Bilal El Khannouss (VfB Stuttgart) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
58' The foul by Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Tobias Stieler.
56' Although Sebastian Hoeness (VfB Stuttgart) is just on the bench, Tobias Stieler has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
54' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
53' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) sends a long cross over to Nicolas Jackson, but Alexander Nubel comes forward to gather the ball.
50' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
50' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) takes a short corner kick.
50' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Bayern Munich get a corner.
48' Close! Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot narrowly over the bar.
47' A raking crossfield pass from Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
46' Vincent Kompany makes a half-time substitution. Josip Stanisic (Bayern Munich) comes on in place of Tom Bischof.
46' Referee Tobias Stieler blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+9' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+9' Flag up against Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
45+7' Tobias Stieler blows for a foul after Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.

45+5' CHANCE! Deniz Undav finds Chema Andres (VfB Stuttgart) with a sweet pass, but he can't find the target as his effort from inside the box goes just wide of the right post! The ball goes out of play and Bayern Munich will have a goal kick.
45+3' Bilal El Khannouss (VfB Stuttgart) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball goes out of play and Bayern Munich will have a goal kick.
45+2' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
45' We will have 8 min. of added time.
44' Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Tobias Stieler didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
43' The goal by Stuttgart is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
41' Wait! Referee Tobias Stieler has indicated he is going to review the Stuttgart goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
40' Nikolas Nartey (VfB Stuttgart) celebrates a beautiful goal. He wins the ball inside the box from the free kick and plants a header inside the left post. 1:1.
39' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Tom Bischof (Bayern Munich) was quite harsh and Tobias Stieler didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
39' Tom Bischof (Bayern Munich) makes a strong challenge and Tobias Stieler blows for a foul. Stuttgart will take a free kick.
38' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
36' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
35' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) took the corner.

34' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom left corner, but Alexander Nubel easily deals with the threat. The ball is out of play and Bayern Munich manage to earn a corner.

33' Poor challenge! Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) is penalised for tripping and Tobias Stieler blows his whistle. Bayern Munich win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
31' Bilal El Khannouss (VfB Stuttgart) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

30' Bilal El Khannouss (VfB Stuttgart) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. Stuttgart have been awarded a corner kick.
30' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
29' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
28' Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.

26' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Nicolas Jackson (Bayern Munich), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Stuttgart.
26' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) commits a rough challenge and Tobias Stieler blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Stuttgart.
24' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
23' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
23' Bilal El Khannouss (VfB Stuttgart) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
22' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alexander Nubel intercepts the ball.
20' Chema Andres (VfB Stuttgart) tries to find Nikolas Nartey, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The linesman signals a throw-in for Bayern Munich.
16' The Stuttgart players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.

11' 0 - 1 Goal! Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) beautifully controls a strongly hit pass from Michael Olise inside the box. He cuts inside his marker and rifles the ball low into the middle of the goal. 0:1.

9' What a chance! The ball rebounds out to Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) and his strike from the edge of the box goes narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayern Munich.
7' A cross from Nicolas Jackson (Bayern Munich) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
4' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) sees a yellow card from Tobias Stieler after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
4' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) trips an opposition player and Tobias Stieler signals a foul. Bayern Munich are awarded a free kick.
4' Nicolas Jackson (Bayern Munich) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Stuttgart will have a goal kick.
2' Ameen Al Dakhil (VfB Stuttgart) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Tobias Stieler ignores the protests.
2' Tobias Stieler interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Ameen Al Dakhil (VfB Stuttgart).
1' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) attempts to create a scoring opportunity with a wonderful long ball, but his pass is blocked.
1' The match has just started.
Bayern Munich will kick-off.
Tobias Stieler will referee today's match.
